## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasSegmentedControl> CreateSegmentedControl( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasSegmentedControl> CreateSegmentedControl( const std::string& identifier, const Rect2Di& bounds);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasSegmentedControl(const std::string &identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
UltraCanvasSegmentedControl(const std::string &identifier, float w, float h);
explicit UltraCanvasSegmentedControl(const std::string &identifier);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onSegmentSelected` | `std::function<void(int)> onSegmentSelected` | Called when selection changes |
| `onSelectionChanged` | `std::function<void(const std::vector<int>&)> onSelectionChanged` | Called when selection changes (multiple mode) |
| `onSegmentClick` | `std::function<void(int)> onSegmentClick` | Called when segment is clicked |
| `onSegmentHover` | `std::function<void(int)> onSegmentHover` | Called when segment is hovered |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

## Option types in this header

### enum `SegmentWidthMode`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Equal` | All segments have equal width |
| `FitContent` | Segments sized to fit their content |
| `Custom` | Custom width per segment |

### enum `SegmentSelectionMode`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Single` | Only one segment can be selected at a time (default) |
| `Multiple` | Multiple segments can be selected simultaneously |
| `Toggle` | Each segment acts as an independent toggle |
